profile.headline: Experienced Web Application Developer. Proficient in JavaScript, VueJs, and more. Skilled in CSS, full-cycle development, and technical translation. Strong focus on efficiency and quality. Let’s connect!
profile.summary:
Dedicated Software Engineer with 7 years of experience across various stages of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Bilingual, with a strong work ethic and a passion for continuous learning, I am confident that I will be a valuable asset to any team.

Seeking positions in Web Application Development, Mobile Development, Software Quality Assurance, or Software Product Support.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Part of the Marketing team with focus on creating experiences for end users that will improve sales responses. As well as with projects that include automating processes by writing microservices using Docker and deploying them in the AWS cloud using AWS pipeline.

Technologies used: PHP, WordPress, Node.js, HTML, CSS, AWS Code Pipeline, AWS S3, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS Service Catalog, Docker, Mac OS X, Python, Local WP, Linux, AWS Lambda, AWS SDK.

Integration of AWS connect to enable video calls for smartmatch.com
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · WordPress · AWS CodePipeline · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Solution Architecture · ECS · Amazon ECS · Docker · Amazon S3 · Docker Products · Breakdance

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing new features and resolving bugs in the cloud-based back-office web application for evidence management as part of the EVO-WEB team. Technologies used: JavaScript, VueJs, expressjs, NodeJS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS SQS and AWS Lambda.

•	Helped the company save thousands of dollars by developing a Lambda function that rips videos and creates storyboard-like thumbnails for the videos which was previously done by an external provider.
•	Led a team of developers, in absence of the team lead, to successfully release a version of the EVO-Web back-office software, helping the company keep their release schedule without any inconvenience.
•	Developed a tool to make the device serialization process easier for the warehouse team, increasing shipping efficiency by 35%.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Engineering · Website Building · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer and Software Architect
positions.description:
Lead developer and Software Architect. Responsible for gathering customer requirements, designing projects, creating wireframes, and ensuring quality assurance. Technologies used: Ionic, Typescript, HTML, WordPress, Wix, and Firebase.

•	Interviewed prospective customers to review the scope of their projects and gather their requirements to translate them into functional requirements.
•	Closed deals to develop websites and apps, generating significant revenue for the company.
•	Fostered a collaborative environment within the company, boosting productivity by 20%.

positions.title: IS Commercial Analyst
positions.description:
Provided Help Desk support for internal customers in the CARICAM (Caribbean and Central American) cluster experiencing issues with their assigned ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) software. Technologies used: SQL Server, ServiceNow, Skype for Business (Teams), MS Excel.

•	Led meetings with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software developers to communicate internal requirements resulting in a 30% reduction in development time.
•	Created the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) forms and monitored the testing to guarantee that the quality of the software developed was optimal, saving thousands of dollars and man-hours of development in the process.
•	Developed dashboards in ServiceNow to accurately represent the metrics of our support team and generate reports every week, serving as a monitoring tool and in compliance with corporate guidelines.
•	Worked side-by-side with the development team to make sure the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) applications contained SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) controls for the company to be compliant with the rules and regulations necessary to be listed in the New York Stock Exchange
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Soporte de software · Análisis de requisitos

positions.title: Backend developer, Team lead, Database admin, Database designer, Server admin
positions.description:
C# REST API design, creation and maintenance, materializing the idea of the app (ASP.netCore 2.2) 
MySql database design, creation and maintenance, giving the project its heart and soul 
AWS instance creation and maintenance, making the front end effectively communicate with the backend, also uploading any fix or new compilation that the backend would have 
System architecture and documentation (Spanish). 
The code of this project can be seen in https://github.com/Therabyteme/Armalo 
Demo the Project in front of a live audience

positions.title: Project Team Lead, Backend developer, Database admin, Project Manager
positions.description:
C# REST API Maintenance, helping to the good sales performance (ASP.net 2.0)  Data migration from MSSQL to MySql, helping to cut expenses in licensing fees 
Android apps development to agilize certain internal processes in the company 
Platform Maintenance, making updates at client’s request and bug fixing 
Tech Support 
Costumer Service, calling clients to see if they were satisfied with the current product, taking their suggestions if there was an issue and hands on support if they needed training on how to use our applications 
Send sales information to the accounting department from our database for them to make the weekly inform needed to be working within the Dominican laws  
System design and analysis, designed the rest API used as a core to all transactions 
Meeting with potential clients to show our software, helping to close a merger between a Grupo Marlton Stakeholder and Union Telecard to form Pibou Group
